title: Clearer mobile contact cards
summary: Made WhatsApp and email cards fully tappable with clearer labels, icon tiles and directional indicators.

changes.detail: Larger contact heading, sentence-case labels, muted details, rounded icon tiles, chevrons and more generous padding.
Expanded mobile links to the whole card with visible keyboard focus and hover feedback. Grouped Moroccan phone digits for readability and synchronized fallback display and WhatsApp destination.
